theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_ic_cycle
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (F : Set (Euclid P)) (C S Ŷ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsCompact F → IsIntegerMultiplicity C → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → S.boundary = C.boundary → (S - C).support ⊆ F → IsIntegerMultiplicity Ŷ → Ŷ.boundary = 0 → Ŷ.support ⊆ F → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = 0 ∧ IsCompact Y.support ∧ Y.support ⊆ F ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Y ω = (S - C) ω + Ŷ ω
